title: Six milestones to a plugin API
subtitle: A public plan for the charting library, first render to extensible core, 2031–2033.

events.name: v0.1 First render
events.detail: Line and bar marks draw from a plain array of numbers. One canvas target, no interaction, no theming.

events.name: v0.4 Scales and axes
events.detail: Linear, time, and ordinal scales, with tick labels chosen from the data range instead of hard-coded.

events.name: v0.7 Interaction layer
events.detail: Hover, tooltip, and range selection, each reachable from the keyboard and announced to screen readers.

events.name: v1.0 Stable API
events.detail: Semantic versioning begins. The mark, scale, and theme contracts are frozen for the whole 1.x line.

events.name: v1.4 Server rendering
events.detail: The same chart definition renders to static SVG without a browser, for documents and email digests.

events.name: v2.0 Plugin API
events.detail: Marks, scales, and themes can ship as separate packages, so the core stops growing with every new chart.

footer: Quarters are targets, not commitments. Scope moves before a date does, and every milestone ships from main.
